definitions.explanation: A customer who buys from a shop or business often and is valued by it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得意客|とくいきゃく}だ。
examples.english: He is a regular at this shop.

examples.japanese: {得意客|とくいきゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: We send invitations to our valued customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得意客|とくいきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}わない→失う：01887_ushinau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The owner handled it carefully so as not to lose a long-time customer.

notes:
⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ here is the old sense "a regular patron", as in ⟦お{得意|とくい}→お得意：09990_otokui⟧さん and ⟦お{得意|とくい}{様|さま}→お得意様：21411_otokuisama⟧, not "good at".

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得意客|とくいきゃく}: a long-standing customer
- {得意客|とくいきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose a valued customer
- ⟦お{得意|とくい}{様|さま}→お得意様：21411_otokuisama⟧: valued customer (polite, used by the business itself)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧: a regular, stressing frequent visits (bars, restaurants)
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: customer, client (formal, business)
